{{Quote|You're joking. ''This'' is the defense for a twenty-five-thousand-year-old treaty?|Turg, shortly before the defense claims Kaara's life|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Kaara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and the sister of fellow Saber [[Vran]]. In [[44 ABY]], Kaara and Vran were part of the crew of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Starstalker]]'' when it was on a mission to [[Mission to the Maw|capture]] the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Sentience/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]]. During a stop at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Vyn Holpur]], sent several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;including Kaara&mdash;to the surface of the planet to obtain [[wintrium]] samples from a natural formation called the [[Fountain of Ancients]]. The [[Fountain Security|local forces]] guarding the Fountain [[Violation|fought back]] against the Sith, and Kaara was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing skirmish.

==Biography==
[[File:Klatooine_LoNH.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Kaara died on Klatooine, serving as part of the Sith fleet.]]
Kaara was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] sometime before the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Like her brother, [[Vran]], she was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and eventually reached the rank of [[Sith Saber]].<ref name="Allies" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Kaara and Vran were among those selected to join the crew of the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Starstalker]]'', which would be part of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] sent to ally with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]&mdash;an unstable and mostly unnavigable cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]]&mdash;to neutralize the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sentience/Legends|being]] [[Abeloth]]. After meeting with Skywalker, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fleet ventured to the planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and waited there for the arrival of one of Skywalker's friends, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who would supply them with a [[Rockhound|ship]] that could help them [[Astrogation/Legends|navigate]] the Maw more easily.<ref name="Allies" />

While in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Klatooine, [[Vyn Holpur]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Starstalker'', received orders from the Sith fleet's leader, [[High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] wanted to obtain some [[wintrium]] samples from a natural formation known as the [[Fountain of Ancients]] that was located on the planet. Kaara, her brother, and fellow Sith Sabers [[Turg]], [[Marjaak]], and [[Anyul]] then took a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] and landed it next to the Fountain to begin the process of taking the samples. However, the group was quickly [[Violation|attacked]] by [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] [[Fountain Security|defending]] the Fountain. As modern technology was forbidden within a one-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] distance of the Fountain, the guards only carried archaic weapons and were not perceived as a threat by Kaara and her companions. That changed when Kaara was hit by an [[Acid/Legends|acid]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that began to tear through her [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and skin. Despite the immense pain she suffered, Kaara [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to her wounds without uttering a word of pain.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
While attempting to obtain wintrium samples from the Fountain of Ancients on Klatooine, Kaara found Turg's comments regarding the native defenders' archaic weapons to be very amusing. She was nevertheless taken by surprise when struck by an acid missile. Despite the significant pain she suffered, Kaara died without saying anything, behavior befitting of a Sith Saber. Like her brother, Vran, Kaara had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Sith Saber, Kaara was [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive and was trained to [[Force power/Legends|wield]] the dark side of the Force. She was skilled with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and could fire accurately even while laughing.<ref name="Allies" />

==Equipment==
During the skirmish at at the Fountain, Kaara wore a full [[Armorweave/Legends|armorweave]] for protection and used a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaara appeared in [[Fate of the Jedi: Allies|''Allies'']], the fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The novel was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" />
